newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Burmese guards seize 15 Bangladeshi fishermen.
newsitem.headline: Burmese guards seize 15 Bangladeshi fishermen.

text.p: Burmese border guards on Tuesday seized a Bangladeshi fishing boat at gunpoint and arrested its 15 crew members, police said.
The vessel was intercepted near Bangladesh's St Martin's island in the Bay of Bengal and forced into Burmese territory, police quoted the vessel's owners as saying.
"We have alerted police in St. Martin's but they couldn't get hold of the boat, F.B. Nusrat," a police officer told reporters at Cox's Bazar.
He said Burma had not yet returned another boat with 15 crew members that was seized by Burmese border guards on January 21.
Owners of both the boats told police they were fishing in Bangladesh's territorial water.
"We are trying to get them freed," the police officer said.
